Such jointly expresses the comparison and deictic reference of כְּ plus אֵלֶּה. This is a discontinuous function-morpheme fusion under rules 25 and 30, not a contiguous כַּאֲשֶׁר compound. Head on the governing comparative under rule 23; the demonstrative is the competing source head. The alternative leaves כְּ unrepresented and gives such to אֵלֶּה alone.
